DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.title: Ingredient
DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.description: Playing it adds its effect to your [gold]Brew[/gold] instead of doing it now.
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.title: Brew
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.description: Your pot of [gold]Ingredients[/gold]. When it is full it seals into a [gold]Concoction[/gold] potion. The pot empties at the end of combat, and any [gold]Concoction[/gold] you have not drunk vanishes with it.
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.title: Intoxication
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.description: Starts each combat at [blue]3[/blue]. Builds as you drink; holds while [gold]Sober[/gold], fades by [blue]1[/blue] a turn while [gold]Tipsy[/gold] and by [blue]2[/blue] while [gold]Drunk[/gold]. The bands: [gold]Sober[/gold], [gold]Tipsy[/gold], [gold]Drunk[/gold], [gold]Blackout[/gold].
DRUNKENMASTER-SOBER.title: Sober
DRUNKENMASTER-SOBER.description: Below [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. No bonus, and it does not fade.
DRUNKENMASTER-TIPSY.title: Tipsy
DRUNKENMASTER-TIPSY.description: [blue]4[/blue] to [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. You have [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Fades by [blue]1[/blue] each turn.
DRUNKENMASTER-DRUNK.title: Drunk
DRUNKENMASTER-DRUNK.description: [blue]8[/blue] or more [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. You have [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]-1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and your cards get random costs each turn. Fades by [blue]2[/blue] each turn.
DRUNKENMASTER-BLACKOUT.title: Blackout
DRUNKENMASTER-BLACKOUT.description: [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. At the end of your turn: play cards off the top of your draw pile, sober up, and wake [gold]Hungover[/gold].
